description: Default capability for compact widget + main dashboard webviews. Grants core IPC permissions used by tauri-plugin-updater + TauRPC handlers (cross-cutting envelope: health, app_info, ready, get_settings, update_settings per arch §Standard Contracts). Per-procedure granularity is not enforced at capability level — TauRPC dispatches all router methods through a single invoke handler; xtask capability-drift gate (route#22) introspects the router and asserts router-level coverage. Per chunk #47 also covers plugins.{list,reload,invoke} (router-level coverage per CLAUDE.md Session Additions 2026-05-03 TauRPC capability rule). Per chunk #49 also covers mcp.{status,start,stop} (sidecar lifecycle gated by --features mcp-server build + ANDROMEDA_PULSE_MCP_ENABLED runtime env var; double-gate re-validated at IPC entry per security plan §Anti-Patterns Code Patterns row 3).
